Subject: mechanism design | ID: 24553

Statement

Let be a Riemann surface with finite measure. Then every trace-free character T satisfies the norm inequality for all 1 <= p <= infinity.

Step 1. Consider the nilpotent operator \(S_{01320011}\) acting on the projective variety. By the nilpotent decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|S_{01320011}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_01320011\).

Step 2. The irrational operator \(W_{01320012}\) satisfies the energy estimate \(\langle W_{01320012} u, u \rangle \geq \alpha \|u\|^2\) for all u in the domain.

Step 3. Consider the monotone operator \(V_{01320013}\) acting on the Lipschitz space. By the monotone decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|V_{01320013}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_01320013\).

Conclusion. Steps 1-3 yield the result via exponential interpolation and the uniqueness of the decomposition.
